glossEn: pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives
note: pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives。线索：choose between A and B / choose to do sth。

glossEn: select as an alternative over another
note: select as an alternative over another。线索：would choose A rather than B / choose to do rather than do。常见结构是 choose + 动词原形 + rather than。

glossEn: see fit or proper to act in a certain way; decide to act in a certain way
note: [WORDNET 补缺 ECDICT 未收录] see fit or proper to act in a certain way; decide to act in a certain way。补缺层收进，ECDICT definition 侧漏导。线索：They chose to remain silent.
